method: Content links only: links inside #sp-component (Joomla main content area). Header menu, off-canvas menu and footer are excluded. The 9-link block that is repeated on all 25 service-tree pages (9 areas + 16 sub pages) is counted but flagged 'via_repeated_block' because it is boilerplate, not a contextual link. Parents come from the URL path and the Leistungen hub (menu has no dropdown). Anchors are derived from page names and need a human edit. Targets are existing 200 pages only.
hard_rules: Nothing is changed in this scan (read only)
Edits to SP Page Builder content need Joomla Super User (741 account is Administrator only: SP Page Builder and Global Config blocked)
No new pages are invented as link targets; a Munich location page does not exist and is a decision, not a link target
Law firm: anchors stay factual (BORA, UWG); no client or case names (§203 StGB)
